notes.title: Hats, new levels, features, and bug fixes, oh my!
notes.notes:
Hello Handsome Mr. Everybody, and thank you so much for your support with this little game so far!

This is the first of a series of content updates we will be doing, which includes select new outfits designed by fans, some usability features that were frequently requested, and game breaking bug patches.

Content:

24 new hats to unlock, designed by fans in a contest prior to release
A new level in each world to add a bit of variety


Features:

A pause menu (duh) that allows you to exit the game.
Highscore board now shows you scores around your score before showing you the top ten Handsomest Frogs.


Bug fixes:

Game no longer crashes when alt-entering to enter/exit fullscreen between levels.
Spitting boxes into a wall no longer can cause an infinite loop which crashes the game.
Altered birbs slightly to avoid them escaping the map and making a level unbeatable.


Again, thanks to everybody who has played the game, designed a hat, reported a bug, or requested a feature, and stay handsome!

-Handsome Mr. Cullen
